设计意图： The parent gated the 60-day slope by a five-day count of daily sign agreement with the trend. This mutation replaces that discrete sign-count with a signed directional-efficiency mechanism over the same horizon: the registered directional_efficiency tool measures five-day net displacement divided by total five-day path length, so it is continuous, magnitude-aware, and bounded. 🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. fillna —— 缺失值填充
    fillna(multiply(subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 60)), 1), fillna(divide(subtract(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 5)), ts_sum(abs(ts_delta(AdjClose, 1)), 5)), )), )
  2. 2. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 60)), 1), fillna(divide(subtract(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 5)), ts_sum(abs(ts_delta(AdjClose, 1)), 5)), ))
  3. 3. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 60)), 1)
  4. 4. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 60))
  5. 5. ts_delay —— 滞后 N 天(取N天前值)
    ts_delay(AdjClose, 60)
  6. 6. fillna —— 缺失值填充
    fillna(divide(subtract(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 5)), ts_sum(abs(ts_delta(AdjClose, 1)), 5)), )
  7. 7. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(subtract(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 5)), ts_sum(abs(ts_delta(AdjClose, 1)), 5))
  8. 8. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 5))
  9. 9. ts_delay —— 滞后 N 天(取N天前值)
    ts_delay(AdjClose, 5)
  10. 10. ts_sum —— 过去 N 天滚动求和
    ts_sum(abs(ts_delta(AdjClose, 1)), 5)
  11. 11. abs —— 取绝对值
    abs(ts_delta(AdjClose, 1))
  12. 12. ts_delta —— N 期差分(今-前N天)
    ts_delta(AdjClose, 1)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 long_ret：close / close.shift(60) - 1.0
  2. 计算 short_eff：alpha_tools.directional_efficiency(df_copy, window=5)
  3. 计算 short_eff：short_eff
  4. 计算 factor：long_ret * short_eff

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_trend_path_efficiency_5_60(df): "str">'''Idea: A long-horizon trend is trustworthy when recent five-day directional progress is efficient; choppy "kw">class="kw">or counter-trend paths signal a phase rupture. Logic: The 60-day "kw">class="kw">return defines the long-horizon trend. The registered directional_efficiency tool returns the signed five-day efficiency ratio (five-day net displacement over total five-day path length). Multiplying the 60-day trend by this signed efficiency keeps the trend when short-horizon progress is aligned "kw">class="kw">and efficient, attenuates it when the path is choppy, "kw">class="kw">and flips it when the short path has retraced against the trend. Sub-mechanism tags: multi_scale_consistency, trend_alignment, path_efficiency, long_horizon_slope. Formula: factor = (close/close.shift(60)-1) * directional_efficiency(close, 5). "str">''' df_copy = df.copy() long_ret = df_copy["str">'close'] / df_copy["str">'close'].shift(60) - 1.0 short_eff = alpha_tools.directional_efficiency(df_copy, window=5) short_eff = short_eff.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0) factor = long_ret * short_eff df_copy["str">'factor_trend_path_efficiency_5_60'] = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0) "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_trend_path_efficiency_5_60']
